videos.headline: John Emery Jr. caps off a 10-play drive with a LSU TD
videos.description: John Emery Jr. punches it in from a yard out to give LSU the 7-0 lead over Purdue.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF One-Play (John Emery Jr. caps off a 10-play drive with a LSU TD) 2023/01/01 ESHEET

videos.headline: Noah Cain scores LSU's 2nd TD of the game
videos.description: Another long LSU drive culminates in a 9-yard TD from Noah Cain.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF One-Play (Noah Cain scores LSU’s 2nd TD of the game) 2023/01/01 ESHEET

videos.headline: Mason Taylor breaks tackles for the 32-yard TD
videos.description: Jayden Daniels finds Mason Taylor, who breaks multiple tackles on his way to a 32-yard score.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF One-Play (Mason Taylor breaks tackles for the 32-yard TD) 2023/01/01 ESHEET

videos.headline: Daniels' big run sets up another Cain TD for LSU
videos.description: Jayden Daniels keeps it himself for a 37-yard run, which sets up Noah Cain from nine yards out on the next play.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF One-Play (Daniels’ big run sets up another Cain TD for LSU) 2023/01/01 ESHEET

videos.headline: LSU trick play sets up 5th TD of the game
videos.description: WR Malik Nabers passes off the jet sweep to Kyren Lacy, which sets up the TD from Brian Thomas Jr. on the following play.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF One-Play (LSU trick play sets up 5th TD of the game) 2023/01/01 ESHEET

videos.headline: WR Malik Naber plays QB again, this time for a 5-yard score
videos.description: Malik Naber passes for the 2nd time of the game, this time to QB Jayden Daniels for the LSU touchdown.

videos.description: Malik Nabers takes the jet sweep and races 75 yards for the LSU touchdown.

videos.headline: Quad Wilson takes it the distance on a 99-yard INT return
videos.description: Quad Wilson puts an exclamation point on LSU's win over Purdue with a 99-yard pick-six.

videos.headline: Nabers helps No. 17 LSU rout Purdue in Citrus Bowl
videos.description: Malik Nabers throws for a touchdown, catches one and has 163 yards receiving in the No. 17 Tigers' 63-7 rout of Purdue in the Citrus Bowl.

videos.headline: Nabers says LSU's win was to build for 2023 season
videos.description: Citrus Bowl MVP Malik Nabers discusses the dominant win vs. Purdue and explains how it will set No. 17 Tigers up for next year.
